class.name: GroundClods3D
class.brief_description: Clods of clay standing on the ground near the camera.
class.description: Lumps of clay as real geometry, from two sources on a [GroundSurface3D]. Clay thrown by tyres and boots that lands (a [method GroundSurface3D.track_mud] with no print) stands up as one to three clods when it holds a lump's volume. Where a print's rim grows in sticky soil, a share of the heaved soil ([member break_share]) is torn out as clods thrown a little away from the print: plastic clay holds together, while sand crumbles and slurry flows (the soil's stickiness). Sizes are log-normal (soil aggregates, Gardner 1956). Each clod is one of eight shared angular shapes, stretched its own way and in a shade of its own clay's colour. A later print that presses it in or heaps over it crushes it, and water standing over it slakes it (Emerson 1967). The path tracer instances them ([method RenderingServer.multimesh_set_rt_instanced]), so it sees every clod. [GroundSurface3D] makes one as an internal child while its [member GroundSurface3D.clods] is on (the default).

method.name: get_clod_count
method.description: Returns the number of clods lying now.

method.name: get_landed_total
method.description: Returns the number of clods stood up from thrown clay that landed, since the node entered the tree.

method.name: get_parked_count
method.description: Returns the number of clods kept while the camera is away from where they lie (in memory; on disk ones are not counted), given back when the print field comes over them again.

method.name: get_spawned_total
method.description: Returns the number of clods made since the node entered the tree, torn out and landed.

method.name: get_update_msec_mean
method.description: Returns the mean main-thread time of an update so far, in milliseconds.

method.name: get_update_msec_worst
method.description: Returns the longest main-thread time of an update so far, in milliseconds.

method.name: get_update_runs
method.description: Returns the number of updates so far.

method.name: update_now
method.description: Takes the landings, scans the print field, checks the clods and draws them now, instead of waiting for the next update (six a second). For tests and tools.
